description:
Delete a sub-account's (project's) custom template, reverting that project to the default template for the channel and message type.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

profile_id.description: The sub-account (project) to act on; omitted → your key's project, or the primary project for an account-wide key

name: delete_template
